author: Honkai: Star Rail
text:
"If you have no other matters to attend to, stay and admire this autumn moon with me."
Stellar Photography

"Once bound by old grudges, I had no desire to linger."
"Only now, with a moment of leisure, can I truly appreciate the courtyard filled with golden osmanthus and the shimmering waters of the pool."
"If you have no other matters to attend to, stay and admire this autumn moon with me."
